audit_comment: APPENDIX 3: THE CLERICAL QUICK-REFERENCE CHARTS, BATCH SIX - the D&DG walk round twenty-six, print p. 141: the sixth batch of deity rows - the thirteen Nehwon rows - riding the roster data file, the block below the R873 Melnibonean tail on the same pdf page; the App 3 gap box stays open until the last chart batch lands. The print voice is the ROTATED tesseract pass, collated against the 1eonline L&L per-deity chart rows. The headline divergences: the print reads the Aarth flags male + female only where the L&L voice reads a third X, and the Red God sphere fire where the L&L voice reads underground areas - pinned by print, eyeball flags.

banner.title: Appendix 3: the clerical quick-reference chart, batch six - the D&DG walk round twenty-six, print p. 141: the 13 rows of the Nehwon mythos across the 13 printed columns.
banner.provenance: primary ink: the ROTATED extract/ddg tesseract pass (pNNN_rot_full.txt + pNNN_rot_tsv.tsv, pdf page 141; the second printing) - the batch rides the pdf 141 block below the R873 Melnibonean tail; the collation voice: the 1eonline L&L per-deity chart rows (the Nehwon slugs run flat). The adjudications: the Aarth male + female pin (print over the L&L third X, eyeball flag), the Red God sphere fire pinned (the L&L voice reads underground areas; the print glyph run reads the short word), the Hate place underground pinned (the garble restored; the L&L voice adds temple), the Earth God name pinned Nehwon Earth God (the pass reads Earth God; the row sorts after Kos and the R863 prose name carries the prefix), the Gods of Lankhmar year-s end and Spider God summer solstice garbles restored, the Red God red-tailed hawk garble and red studded leather fold restored, the Rat God M + N-H geometry (no F X; the L&L voice agrees), the Tyaa female-only flag (the single X at the F column), and the Gods of Trouble stray dot noted. The batch order runs the Nehwon walk (Aarth through Votishal).
